deflect.doc: The plasma sword's deflect mark (view only; DeflectMarks via CombatArena.deflected, FxView). On the bat frame: a cream starburst edged in ink, burst_m across, for flash_ticks; and a cream streak running streak_m along the returned round, fading over streak_ticks, so the round reads as sent back by the swing. flash_ticks 0 = none; --feel=off hides it too.

doc: Lane n7-melee: view-only marks of Rivet's melee that are not a camera effect (those are hit_feel.json rows). Metres and 60 Hz ticks.
